learning_outcomes.text: This specialised mechanics course enables students to develop the design of parts produced by additive manufacturing, whether polymer or metal, through the optimal introduction of lattice structures.
In practice, students choose a subject for study, produce a topologically optimised part design, determine lattice zones, produce a complete CAD model and simulate it using finite elements.
Optimal design by topological optimisation using Inspire® software, with determination of solid zones and lattice zones.
Analysis of manufacturing constraints, depending on the type of technology considered.
Design method for parts with lattice structures, using Catia® software.
Analysis of the mechanical (and possibly thermal) performance of lattice patterns using Abaqus® software.
Complete analysis of the part (possibly by homogenising the lattice zones).
Possibly, production of the part using polymer printing.

degree: Titre d'ingénieur ENIT (cycle ingénieur, semestres 5-10; orientación mecánica/producción)
